description: A question the orchestrator can answer from the skill text alone. It must answer directly and dispatch no worker.
query: Quick question before we start: which of your workers reviews hard-tier work, and may it edit files? One sentence, please.
expected_behavior: Answers in one short message that the hard-tier reviewer is review-hard and that it is read-only
Dispatches no worker: the question is trivia answerable from context (SKILL.md section 3, 'Do not delegate trivia')
